fact: The Ministry's statistical abstract for academic year 2025, compiled from the redeveloped EMIS, states that 26,597 primary schools responded to the EMIS data upload out of 45,164 primary schools in the country (12,511 government, 14,086 private), reporting 11,787,396 learners; it describes EMIS as collecting individual learner-level data on enrolment with a Learner Identification Number, and names no entry of attendance or results.
title: The Education Statistics Abstract 2025 (Volume 1)
